title: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Limited (TARIL): Business, Valuation and Portfolio Action
primer: TARIL designs and builds power, furnace, rectifier and special transformers for utility and industrial customers. The business has technical qualifications and recent growth, but FY26 operating cash flow was negative ₹105.38 crore despite higher profit and the cash-conversion cycle widened to about 200 days. New capital waits for support at ₹299.92–₹314.51 with a ₹292.47 stop; the existing 850-share holding stays under an advisory exit rule below that level. The next marginal cash unit remains in cash, and broad Stage 2 flow coverage is provisional because the dashboard filters failed.

verdict_rule_summary: For TARIL, WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT means the current price is too close to the support zone to add. Re-underwrite at support; require both intact business evidence and a forward expected return that clears the 12% annual hurdle. Stage 3 ledger status and failed TheWrap verification leave the timing case unconfirmed.
